title: Ford GT in the Loft in Heavy Rain
label: RAINY NIGHTS
description:
Rainy Nights: a satin black Ford GT in the loft in heavy rain, water pouring down the windows while it stays warm and dry inside. 8 hours of deep brown noise, no music, for sleeping, studying, or blocking out the world while you work.

No music. No talking. No sudden sounds. Seamless from start to finish, so nothing wakes you up.

PARKED FM | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
